name: DriftX Legends
summary: Welcome to DriftX Legends – the ultimate drifting experience! Slide through challenging tracks with precision and style. Customize your car's performance, paint, and wheels to match your driving flair. With realistic physics and responsive controls, every drift feels authentic and satisfying. Compete in various game modes, climb the leaderboard, and unlock legendary cars. Whether you're drifting in city streets or mountain passes, DriftX Legends delivers adrenaline-packed action for drift lovers worldwide!
